question: Does the DSpine block drafter (tencent/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpine-b16, 5 layers, block 16, SWA 8192) make Bonsai 2 27B decode faster than the shipped MTP head on the RTX 4070 12 GB? Issue #258 (idea: Milor123).
engine: fork branch research/dspine = 21fd9beda (serve/eog-think, the bundle-20261105 engine) + the DSpine part of ggml-org/llama.cpp#31941 (b44fcf816) + the DFlash causal-attention flag from ggml-org ca3d5a3e1; built for sm_89 (89-real). Every arm uses this one binary.

cells.step1_short: a, b, c3, c7, c15, d3, d7, d15 at depth 1500
cells.step2_depth: a, b, best c, best d at depth 16000 and 32000 (best = highest mean decode of code and prose in step 1)

method: Fresh server per arm and per depth. Per cell: warm-up request, then the code prompt and the prose prompt, each with its own filler (Python stdlib source for code, wikitext for prose) sized to the depth with the server tokenizer; 2 requests per prompt (the second reads the prompt from the cache, so prefill comes from the first); greedy (temperature 0, top-k 1), thinking off, 400 tokens. Record decode and prefill tok/s, draft_n and draft_n_accepted (server timings), VRAM after load and peak, memory clock while busy, the first 200 characters of each text (full texts in texts.jsonl).
gate: ADOPT a DSpine quant only if its decode tok/s beats arm b (MTP as shipped) by >= 8 % on BOTH the code and the prose prompt at EVERY tested depth (1.5k, 16k, 32k).
AND its greedy text equals or closely matches arm a (no draft): rounding-level differences are allowed and noted; broken or repeated text fails.
AND its VRAM cost is recorded with the effect on the 12 GB 262k product (the tiered-KV VRAM line), labeled as an estimate.
Per-cell differences below 5 % are noise (one request per cell, 2 repeats). A result between 5 % and 8 % is reported as 'not shown'.
All arms on the same memory clock (11751 MHz Afterburner OC or 10251 stock): a clock change between arms makes the comparison invalid and the step is repeated.
stop_rule: If DSpine does not load or crashes on the ternary target and a fix needs large engine changes, stop, log why, and report that as the result.

amendment_1.declared: 2026-11-12 12:33, after the load checks (DS0 in runs.jsonl), before any speed cell
amendment_1.finding: The plain DSpine files load and run, but on Bonsai 2 the acceptance is 0.4-0.5 % (DS0a). The same files on the full-precision Qwen3.8-27B (UD-Q4_K_M) accept 91 % (DS0b), so the port is correct. A DFlash draft without its own output head uses the target's head; Bonsai's head is ternary (PTQ1_0). With the Qwen3.8-27B output head (Q6_K, 1.0 GB) put in the draft file, the acceptance on Bonsai is 80 % (DS0c). The Qwen token embeddings make no difference (DS0c).
amendment_1.change: Arms c and d use the draft files with the Qwen3.8-27B output head: Qwen3.8-27B-DSpine-b16-q8_0-qhead.gguf and Qwen3.8-27B-DSpine-b16-q4_0-qhead.gguf (made with bench/graft_target_tensors.py). The plain files are reported from DS0 only. Arms, depths, gate and noise rule are unchanged.

b.what: MTP head as shipped on 12 GB (draft 2, draft window 16k, shared pool, MTP draft ubatch 256)

bt.what: b with the template of the a / c / d model file (same prompt tokens in every arm)
